{{Top|leg}}
'''Thermal gliding''' was a recreational activity popular on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]]. Using [[Glider (vehicle)/Legends|gliders]] made of animal skin or light-weight [[Polymer/Legends|polymer]]s, [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] launched themselves from high points and used the natural occurring [[Thermal well (Socorro)|thermal wells]] to stay aloft. Speeds of forty-five [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] were not uncommon, and the gliders were a common sight near the outskirts of [[Soco-Jarel Spaceport]].<ref name="BSS">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref>
